{{Quote|This is Galactic Alliance Ship ''Rinkin Four'', inbound to Corellia. We have an emergency. Please reply. Over.|Unidentified Human navigator|<ref name="MK" />}}
This  '''individual''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as an [[Ensign/Legends|Ensign]] and [[Navigator/Legends|navigator]] in the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Defense Fleet|Navy]] support-and-supply division.<ref name="MK" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> he was serving aboard the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] '' [[Rinkin IV]]'' on its way to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] when the ship was suddenly pulled out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. The ship's [[Unidentified Ortolan pilot (Rinkin IV)|pilot]] quickly attempted to determine their position and noticed that none of their escorts had emerged with them except for an unknown capital ship. He reported this to the ship's [[Unidentified Rinkin IV captain|captain]] via the [[Comm board|comm board]], and the navigator was ordered to send a distress signal over the ship's [[Hypercomm/Legends|hypercomm]] using an emergency naval frequency. As the captain made her way onto the bridge, a [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]] was thrown in their direction, prompting the navigator to bravely leap onto it and cover it with his body. However, it failed to explode, as it was in fact a [[Gas grenade/Legends|gas grenade]] that rendered everyone on the bridge unconscious.<ref name="MK" />
